title: Halloween and Farewell to No Agenda
description: Steven talks about Halloween weekend in Beijing, his half-joking theory that Halloween kicks off China's manufacturing rush, and how AI now handles much of his video editing in Final Cut Pro. The main story is the five-hour finale of the No Agenda podcast after 19 years, plus his deadlift numbers, plans to restart his English-teaching podcast, and Gogol's "St. John's Eve" for night two of his Halloween special.

sentences.zh: 内容速览
sentences.en: Episode Overview

sentences.zh: 今天这期节目，史蒂文聊了北京的万圣节周末，还半开玩笑地提出一个理论：万圣节是中国“制造业冲刺季”的起点。
sentences.en: In today's episode, Steven talks about Halloween weekend in Beijing and half-jokingly puts forward a theory: Halloween marks the start of China's "manufacturing sprint season."

sentences.zh: 他也讲了AI怎样帮他省下好几个小时的剪辑时间。
sentences.en: He also talks about how AI saved him several hours of editing time.

sentences.zh: 节目的重头戏，是《No Agenda》这档播客在播出19年后，用长达五小时的告别节目画上句号，以及这件事给他的启发。
sentences.en: The centerpiece of the episode is how the podcast No Agenda wrapped up after 19 years on the air with a five-hour farewell episode, and what he took away from it.

sentences.zh: 此外，他还聊了硬拉成绩、重启英语教学播客的想法，以及万圣节特辑的第二夜：果戈理的《圣约翰之夜》。
sentences.en: He also talks about his deadlift numbers, his idea of restarting his English-teaching podcast, and the second night of the Halloween special: Gogol's "St. John's Eve."

sentences.zh: 忘掉的糖果与AI来救场
sentences.en: Forgotten Candy and AI to the Rescue

sentences.zh: 万圣节快乐！
sentences.en: Happy Halloween!

sentences.zh: 史蒂文向学生们道了声节日快乐，学生们的反应差不多是：“然后呢？糖呢？”
sentences.en: Steven wished his students a happy holiday, and their reaction was pretty much: "So what? Where's the candy?"

sentences.zh: 其实他本来打算买一大袋最便宜的糖果，结果忘得一干二净。
sentences.en: Actually, he had planned to buy a big bag of the cheapest candy, but he completely forgot.

sentences.zh: 原因是昨天那期节目耗时太久，一直忙到晚上八点半。
sentences.en: The reason was that yesterday's episode took too long, and he was busy until 8:30 in the evening.

sentences.zh: 往年他得亲手剪每一段视频，这次AI先把节目转成文字，再生成了标好剪辑点的Final Cut Pro XML文件。
sentences.en: In past years he had to cut every video clip by hand; this time AI first transcribed the episode into text, then generated a Final Cut Pro XML file with the edit points already marked.

sentences.zh: AI甚至帮他发现了一个疏漏：他录音用的是iPhone上的大疆麦克风，而不是音色更饱满的Shure。
sentences.en: AI even helped him spot an oversight: he had recorded with the DJI mic on his iPhone instead of the fuller-sounding Shure.

sentences.zh: 用他的话说：“你瞧，AI来救场了。”
sentences.en: In his words: "See, AI saved the day."

sentences.zh: 万圣节拉开了中国制造业旺季的序幕
sentences.en: Halloween kicks off the peak season for Chinese manufacturing

sentences.zh: 学校没有什么万圣节活动，史蒂文便半开玩笑地对学生说，万圣节是“中国制造业冲刺的开始”。
sentences.en: The school didn't have any Halloween activities, so Steven half-jokingly told his students that Halloween is "the start of China's manufacturing sprint."

sentences.zh: 接下来是双十一、圣诞、新年，然后是情人节。
sentences.en: Next come Singles' Day, Christmas, New Year, and then Valentine's Day.

sentences.zh: 他由此琢磨出一个理论：2月14日是固定的，春节却可能落在1月中旬到2月中旬之间。
sentences.en: From this he worked out a theory: February 14 is fixed, but Chinese New Year can fall anywhere between mid-January and mid-February.

sentences.zh: 春节来得早，工厂给情人节商品备货的时间就少；来得晚，备货就更充裕。
sentences.en: When Chinese New Year comes early, factories have less time to stock up on Valentine's goods; when it comes late, they have more time to prepare.

sentences.zh: 不过话说回来，情人节到底有什么东西是中国制造的？
sentences.en: But then again, what exactly is made in China for Valentine's Day?

sentences.zh: 也许他想错了。
sentences.en: Maybe he got it wrong.

sentences.zh: 学生们对这番高论毫不买账，于是大家改做口语活动，聊最喜欢的糖果和角色。
sentences.en: The students weren't buying this grand theory at all, so everyone switched to a speaking activity, chatting about their favorite candy and characters.

sentences.zh: 学生切换到英语状态要花一两分钟，但一旦进入状态，就聊得很起劲。
sentences.en: It takes the students a minute or two to switch into English mode, but once they get going, they chat enthusiastically.

sentences.zh: 被直播搞得分心
sentences.en: Distracted by the livestream

sentences.zh: 屏幕和闪光灯太多，史蒂文有点分心。
sentences.en: With so many screens and flashing lights, Steven got a bit distracted.

sentences.zh: 他甚至想过，除了TikTok，再往Substack同步直播。
sentences.en: He even thought about streaming to Substack at the same time, on top of TikTok.

sentences.zh: 可OBS在他的电脑上一直用不顺，所以现在是一台设备跑TikTok，另一台拍素材，电脑再录一份备份，问题大多就解决了。
sentences.en: But OBS never ran smoothly on his computer, so now one device runs TikTok, another shoots footage, and the computer records a backup, which mostly solves the problem.

sentences.zh: 《No Agenda》十九年后收官
sentences.en: No Agenda wraps up after nineteen years

sentences.zh: 说到信号，节目真的结束了。
sentences.en: Speaking of the signal, the show really has ended.

sentences.zh: 五小时的最终回，从北京时间凌晨一直播到将近上午九点，临近结尾时，史蒂文差点掉下泪来。
sentences.en: The five-hour finale ran from the early hours of the morning Beijing time until nearly 9 a.m., and near the end Steven almost cried.

sentences.zh: 这一期没有一贯的媒体解构，只有感谢。
sentences.en: This episode had none of the usual media deconstruction, only thanks.

sentences.zh: 主持人亚当·柯里念了一长串名单，感谢护士、一线工作者和世界各地的听众，中途哽咽了一次。
sentences.en: Host Adam Curry read out a long list of names, thanking nurses, frontline workers and listeners around the world, and choked up once along the way.

sentences.zh: 这档节目由前MTV主持人柯里和资深科技专栏作家约翰·C·德沃夏克共同创办。
sentences.en: The show was co-founded by former MTV host Curry and veteran tech columnist John C. Dvorak.

sentences.zh: 德沃夏克今年7月住院后离世，享年80岁。
sentences.en: Dvorak was hospitalized this July and passed away afterward, at the age of 80.

sentences.zh: 他录完一期节目，说了句“周四见”，不久便撒手人寰。
sentences.en: He finished recording an episode, said "see you Thursday," and passed away soon after.

sentences.zh: 史蒂文得知消息时哭了一场，尽管“我从没见过这个人，他只是一个声音”。
sentences.en: Steven cried when he heard the news, even though "I never met the man, he was just a voice."

sentences.zh: 柯里最终决定，没有搭档就不再继续。
sentences.en: Curry finally decided he wouldn't continue without his co-host.

sentences.zh: 史蒂文理解这个选择。
sentences.en: Steven understands this choice.

sentences.zh: “价值换价值”与他的捐款
sentences.en: "Value for value" and his donation

sentences.zh: 《No Agenda》的独特之处在于“价值换价值”模式：没有广告，听众一起来“制作”节目。
sentences.en: What makes No Agenda unique is its "value for value" model: there are no ads, and listeners help "produce" the show together.

sentences.zh: 听众可以贡献时间、才华和金钱：参加线下聚会，制作专辑封面或文字稿，或者捐款，贡献者还能在IMDb上署名为制作人。
sentences.en: Listeners can contribute time, talent and money: going to meetups, making album art or transcripts, or donating, and contributors can even be credited as producers on IMDb.

sentences.zh: 史蒂文也承认，《No Agenda》太愤世嫉俗时，他有时得先歇一歇。
sentences.en: Steven also admits that when No Agenda gets too cynical, he sometimes has to take a break from it.

sentences.zh: 毕竟有时候政客只是愚蠢，不必非得扯上阴谋。
sentences.en: After all, sometimes politicians are just stupid; there doesn't have to be a conspiracy behind it.

sentences.zh: 他捐了75美元，不够让主持人在节目里念出名字，但他觉得，这些年一直在聊这档节目，再加上今天这番话，自己也算尽了一份心。
sentences.en: He donated 75 dollars, not enough to get his name read out on the show, but he feels that between talking about the show all these years and what he's said today, he's done his part.

sentences.zh: 如果能问这位“播客教父”一个问题，他会问：最初的灵感是什么？
sentences.en: If he could ask the "Podfather" one question, he would ask: what was the original inspiration?

sentences.zh: 愿德沃夏克安息。
sentences.en: May Dvorak rest in peace.

sentences.zh: 健身数据与重启英语播客的念头
sentences.en: Workout numbers and the idea of restarting an English podcast

sentences.zh: 今天早上，史蒂文一边在健身房听节目的最后几个小时，一边练硬拉：系腰带拉了一次130公斤，又拉了两次125公斤。
sentences.en: This morning at the gym, Steven did deadlifts while listening to the last few hours of the show: one rep at 130 kg with a belt, then two reps at 125 kg.

sentences.zh: 现在的问题是时间，不是力量。
sentences.en: The problem now is time, not strength.

sentences.zh: 9点55分上课，7点半健身完还得赶回家、找自行车，到办公室打印资料才能进教室。
sentences.en: Class starts at 9:55, so after finishing his workout at 7:30 he still has to rush home, get his bike, and print materials at the office before he can go into the classroom.

sentences.zh: 日子过得飞快，但他没什么好抱怨的：学生好，学校好，工作也好。
sentences.en: The days fly by, but he has nothing to complain about: the students are good, the school is good, and the job is good too.

sentences.zh: 这让他想重启自己的英语教学播客，面向想听熟悉老师讲清楚易懂英语的学生，以及好奇这份工作究竟什么样的人。
sentences.en: This makes him want to restart his English-teaching podcast, aimed at students who want to hear a familiar teacher speak clear, easy-to-understand English, and at people curious about what this job is really like.

sentences.zh: 它会比现在这档节目更专业：不说脏话，也不聊阴谋论。
sentences.en: It would be more professional than this current show: no swearing, and no talk about conspiracy theories.

sentences.zh: Claude剪辑与万圣节特辑
sentences.en: Editing with Claude and the Halloween Special

sentences.zh: 他的新流程是：Final Cut Pro自动生成字幕，导出后交给Claude。
sentences.en: His new workflow: Final Cut Pro automatically generates subtitles, and after exporting them he hands them to Claude.

sentences.zh: Claude能找出停顿、重来和卡壳的地方，再把剪辑写进FCP XML文件。
sentences.en: Claude can find the pauses, retakes and stumbles, and then write the edits into an FCP XML file.

sentences.zh: 以前要花一小时的活，现在十五到二十分钟就搞定。
sentences.en: Work that used to take an hour now gets done in fifteen to twenty minutes.

sentences.zh: 这才有了这次为期两天的万圣节特辑。
sentences.en: That's what made this two-day Halloween special possible.

sentences.zh: 昨天讲的是《巴巴雅嘎》和《美丽的瓦西丽莎》。
sentences.en: Yesterday's stories were "Baba Yaga" and "Vasilisa the Beautiful."

sentences.zh: 今晚是果戈理的《圣约翰之夜》，满是巴萨夫留克这类斯拉夫名字。
sentences.en: Tonight it's Gogol's "St. John's Eve," full of Slavic names like Basavryuk.

sentences.zh: “幸好有AI帮忙剪辑。”
sentences.en: "Good thing I have AI to help with the editing."

sentences.zh: 当然，结尾他还是念砸了。
sentences.en: Of course, he still botched the reading at the end.

sentences.zh: 今日总结
sentences.en: Today's Summary

sentences.zh: 节目会落幕，朋友会离去，但十九年“价值换价值”的播客告诉我们，一位执着的创作者加上一群忠实的听众，能共同创造出多么了不起的东西。
sentences.en: Shows come to an end and friends move on, but nineteen years of the "Value for Value" podcast show us what remarkable things one dedicated creator and a group of loyal listeners can create together.

sentences.zh: 对史蒂文来说，这是继续做出更多、更好节目的动力，如今还多了一点AI的助力。
sentences.en: For Steven, this is the motivation to keep making more and better shows—and now with a little help from AI.

vocab.en: to save the day, step in at the last minute
to buy into, be convinced by
to choke up, voice breaking with emotion
to come to an end, wrap up
